title: SMALL ART TOUCHES: PACK BUCKLE, BOOT LACES, JERSEY SHADOW
why: His answer 75 (10-18): finish the small art touches. The default pack gets a dark lower seam, a strap and a steel buckle; the boots get two pale lace dots behind the toe cap; the jersey 23 gets a soft ink shadow so it reads off the red. All inside the old outlines, so no anchor moves.
now: Packs, boots and the jersey number have finer drawn detail.
